name: Ginzburg-Landau
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
                                                The complex Ginzburg-Landau equation describes a vast variety of phenomena from nonlinear 
waves to second-order phase transitions, from superconductivity, superfluidity, and 
Bose-Einstein condensation to liquid crystals and strings in field theory. 
<a href="http://hopf.chem.brandeis.edu/yanglingfa/pattern/cgle/index.html">
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Ginzburg-Landau" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="alpha">
        0.076
      </param>
      <param name="beta">
        0.9
      </param>
      <param name="delta">
        1.31
      </param>
      <param name="gamma">
        0.0999
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.23
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.151
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        1.5
      </param>
      <param name="mag_mult">
        22
      </param>
      <param name="mag_sub">
        0.4
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_alpha">
        0.03
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_beta">
        -0.02
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_delta">
        -0.03
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_gamma">
        0.02
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_Da">
        -0.7
      </param>
      <param name="mag_to_Db">
        -0.6
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
        c = pow(a*a + b*b,mag_power) * mag_mult - mag_sub;
delta_a = D_a * laplacian_a + (alpha + c * mag_to_alpha ) * a - ( gamma + c * mag_to_gamma ) * b + ( -( beta + c * mag_to_beta ) * a + ( delta + c * mag_to_delta ) * b ) * (a*a+b*b);
delta_b = D_b * laplacian_b + (alpha + c * mag_to_alpha ) * b + ( gamma + c * mag_to_gamma ) * a + ( -( beta + c * mag_to_beta ) * b - ( delta + c * mag_to_delta ) * a ) * (a*a+b*b);
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
